description: Quote following a trading model (max plan): checks the model is live and followable, validates the follower's sizing (fixed_notional usd, or proportional bps of their balance) and caps (max_notional_usd, max_open_positions, max_daily_loss_usd, markets the model trades), and shows what one mirror would be at the given balance. Creates nothing and moves nothing.

balance_usd.description: the follower's balance, to show a mirror's size (optional)

model.description: the model's attribution from the models tool

name: follow_quote
